description: This file defines an abstract class 'Message' implementing the PSR-7 MessageInterface, providing methods for handling HTTP message properties such as protocol version, headers, and body.

classes.name: Message
classes.description: An abstract class implementing PSR-7 MessageInterface, managing HTTP message properties such as headers, protocol version, and body.

methods.name: getProtocolVersion
methods.description: Returns the current HTTP protocol version.

methods.name: withProtocolVersion
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified HTTP protocol version after validation.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns all headers as an array.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Retrieves the values of a specific header.

methods.name: getHeaderLine
methods.description: Returns the header values as a comma-separated string.

methods.name: withHeader
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified header set.

methods.name: withAddedHeader
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified header added.

methods.name: withoutHeader
methods.description: Returns a new instance without the specified header.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Returns the message body as a StreamInterface.

methods.name: withBody
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified body.
